value: bufferStore\.i32\(i32 69, %dx\.types\.Handle %[\w.]+, i32 0, i32 undef, i32 42, i32 43, i32 44
note: Symptom = the const-qualified struct-of-matrix init `const S a = {m};` is folded from m's DECLARATION-time constants (42,43,44 / 45,46,47) rather than the values written to m at runtime (1,2,3 / 4,5,6) immediately before the init. The anchor is the first BufferStore call carrying the literal declaration-time row (42,43,44); a correct compile emits 1,2,3 there instead, so the anchor cannot be satisfied by a clean/fixed compile. The handle SSA name is NOT anchored literally: v1.4.1907 names it %buffer_UAV_rawbuf while main-debug and newer releases print %1 -- using a literal %1 anchor scored v1.4.1907 no-repro on first attempt even though its disassembly (out-v1.4.1907.txt) carries the identical buggy 42,43,44/45,46,47 payload; `%[\w.]+` is structural and portable across both spellings. CONTROL: variant-noconst.hlsl is the reporter's own 'valid' case -- identical shader with `S a = {m};` (no const) -- which the reporter confirms correctly stores 1,2,3/4,5,6; run with --expect no-match to prove the predicate discriminates the const-vs-non-const behavior rather than matching every compile of this shader.
